description: We are looking for an experienced Scripting & Automation Engineer to lead the modernization of legacy backend scripts, automation workflows, and data pipelines. Automated Testing Strategy: Build comprehensive unit and integration tests (Test::More for Perl, pytest for Python) to validate feature parity between network and local execution environments. Pipeline & Workflow Updates: Reconfigure Windows Scheduled Tasks, CI/CD pipelines, and PowerShell build scripts to execute scripts and tools natively on local disk storage. End-to-End Delivery: Take ownership of migrating legacy scripts, automation flows, and backend tasks from initial network path analysis through local verification and production rollout. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of hands-on software development and automation experience with Perl and Python in a Windows environment. Strong knowledge of Windows file systems (NTFS), network pathing mechanics (UNC format vs. local paths), process execution, and environment variables. Practical experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate code conversion, script generation, and refactoring. Deep understanding of dependency management tools across both stacks (CPAN, local::lib, Carton, pip, venv, poetry, uv). Communicate technical solutions and progress effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Minimum of 8 years of professional software engineering experience designing and building scalable backend systems and cloud-native applications. Strong experience developing applications using C# and modern .NET. Strong experience designing cloud-native applications using AWS and serverless architectures. Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture. Strong experience designing and developing event-driven applications using messaging and event streaming technologies such as Amazon EventBridge, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS/SNS, or similar. Experience designing and developing reusable backend services, RESTful APIs, and system integrations. Experience building workflow automation, business process orchestration, or event-driven business applications. Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including data modelling and performance optimisation. Experience defining and maintaining cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, with practical experience of AWS CloudFormation. Good understanding of Kubernetes and modern cloud deployment environments. Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability practices for production systems. Strong understanding of secure software development principles and cloud security best practices. Experience designing highly available, resilient, business-critical software systems. Ability to analyse complex business processes and design scalable software solutions that automate workflows and improve operational efficiency. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills. Nice to Have Experience within financial services, payments, banking, or other regulated industries. description: Location : Pune About Team & About Role: As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains. We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team. Responsibilities Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems. Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions. Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought. Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic. Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly. Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed. Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET. Experience with directory and identity integration, including Active Directory, LDAP, RADIUS, SAML, and MFA providers. Proficiency with packet-capture analysis and structured troubleshooting of authentication and connectivity issues. Experience with high-availability pair operations, firmware upgrades, and certificate lifecycle management. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical users. title: Graduate Apprenticeship Trainee - Helpdesk
description: Overview: Bruker is enabling scientists to make breakthrough discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. Bruker’s high-performance scientific instruments and high-value analytical and diagnostic solutions enable scientists to explore life and materials at molecular, cellular and microscopic levels. In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy and nano analysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics and proteomics research and clinical microbiology. Today, worldwide more than 11,000 employees are working on this permanent challenge at over 90 locations on all continents. Bruker continues to build upon its extensive range of products and solutions, its broad base of installed systems and a strong reputation among its customers. Being one of the world's leading analytical instrumentation companies, Bruker is strongly committed to further fully meeting its customers’ needs as well as to continue to develop state-of-the-art technologies and innovative solutions for today's analytical questions. Bruker India invites fresh graduates and aspiring professionals to be a part of our prestigious Graduate Apprenticeship Program, launched under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS). This is a gateway to begin your professional journey with one of the world’s leading scientific instrumentation companies, committed to innovation, learning, and development. This structured 12-month program offers immersive learning experiences across various business functions, giving you real-time exposure to operations, technologies, and corporate dynamics. Responsibilities: In-depth working on Salesforce Service Max for case logging and management Vonage calls handling, following escalation procedures, and documentation Using remote diagnostic tools for initial issue identification Understanding log file analysis and system performance checks Shadowing experienced engineers during remote support sessions Learning how to guide customers through basic troubleshooting steps. Assisting customers with preventive maintenance tasks Engaging in advanced troubleshooting techniques Handling customer interactions and conflict resolution Contributing to the internal knowledge base and documentation. Gain hands-on experience with demo systems and software testing. Collaborating with field service engineers and other teams. Professional Growth: Learn from experienced mentors and industry leaders while working on live projects and tools. Skill Development: Sharpen your technical and analytical skills through structured training and on-the-job learning. Cross-functional Collaboration: Gain end-to-end business insights while working closely with diverse teams. Innovation Exposure: Be part of a company that empowers scientific discovery with cutting-edge solutions. Qualifications: Recent graduates (Bachelor’s) in Engineering in Electronics & communication, Instrumentation, Bachelor’s or Masters in Physics/Electronics/Instrumentation.
company_description:
We are a developer, manufacturer and distributor of high-performance scientific instruments and analytical and diagnostic solutions that enable our customers to explore life and materials at microscopic, molecular and cellular levels. Many of our products are used to detect, measure and visualize structural characteristics of chemical, biological and industrial material samples.

In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy & Nano analysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics, proteomics research and clinical microbiology.

Responsibilities Job ID R-264538 Date posted 11/17/2026 Job Title: Senior Consultant - AI Platform Lead Location: Chennai GCL: D3 Introduction to role: Are you ready to lead an enterprise AI platform that turns trusted data and agentic systems into real outcomes for patients and the business? This is your chance to build the foundation that powers secure, reliable AI assistants and a knowledge graph used across drug discovery, development and operations. In this hands-on technical role, you will set the technical direction, own the graph and agentic platform end to end, and enable teams across the company to deliver with speed and confidence. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, security and platform partners to improve on quality, reliability and operational excellence. What could your platform unlock next quarter for scientists and decision-makers? Accountabilities: Graph Platform Ownership: Operate and evolve the knowledge graph and graph database platform to enterprise standards, ensuring performance, availability, backup/restore, access management and smooth operations; make graph and other data stores readily usable by AI agents through secure tools, accelerating insight generation. Agentic AI Orchestration: Define and implement secure agent orchestration through gateways, build and maintain MCP servers and tool layers with clear guardrails, and establish reusable patterns for prompt, skill and tool management; continuously evaluate agents with automated benchmarks to improve quality, cost and latency. Secure Access Management: Provide a consistent, secure access layer to AI tools and internal applications; maintain shared sign-in services, protect credentials and enforce authorization so users can only access what they are entitled to, reducing risk and simplifying adoption. Cloud and Kubernetes Operations: Deploy and run workloads on Kubernetes using Helm with robust ingress, secrets management, storage sizing and per-pull-request review environments; provision infrastructure as code across Azure, AWS and GCP to keep deployments portable and resilient. Data Ingestion at Scale: Build and operate reliable, resumable bulk ingestion pipelines for multi-terabyte datasets across graph, analytical and search stores; process large Parquet datasets efficiently, manage deltas and staged releases to ensure fast, trustworthy data availability. CI/CD and GitOps Enablement: Design and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines for build, test, review apps and deployment (including self-hosted runners) and run deployments using GitOps to deliver frequent, safe changes. Full-Stack Application Delivery: Build and maintain backend services in Python and frontends in React/TypeScript with strong authentication, validation, pagination and versioning; own services end to end from design through deployment, monitoring and support to create reliable developer and user experiences. Technical Leadership and Enablement: Set platform priorities and direction, review designs and pull requests, mentor engineers, and partner with data, NLP, application, security and identity teams; create architecture documents, runbooks and integration guides, and communicate designs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences to scale impact across the organization. Essential Skills/Experience: 8+ years in platform, DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering, including experience leading technical work or mentoring others. Working knowledge of knowledge graphs, and hands-on experience with graph databases such as Neo4J. Experience writing skills and building gateway-based agent orchestration for LLM-based assistants. Expertise in processing Parquet data at scale (with PyArrow, pandas, Polars or Spark), including partitioning, schema handling and memory-efficient loading. Full-stack development experience: Python with FastAPI for REST APIs, React with TypeScript for frontends, and the ability to maintain and upgrade existing applications and dependencies. Ability to collaborate effectively with Databricks platform and data teams, including integrating with data they produce. Strong Python and shell scripting for automation and tooling. Deep experience with Kubernetes and Helm, and hands-on experience across Azure, AWS and GCP. Good experience with CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and GitOps. Hands-on experience implementing single sign-on MSAL against Microsoft Entra ID, both frontend (React) and backend applications. Solid grounding in authentication and authorization: OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, Microsoft Entra ID and API gateway concepts. Experience running data stores in production. Infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or similar) and sound secrets management. Clear written communication and good documentation habits. Desirable Skills/Experience: Hands-on experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or AI gateways. Experience with API gateways and proxies. Large-scale data ingestion (multi-terabyte) and database performance tuning. Observability tooling. Interest in life sciences or biomedical data. When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world. Why AstraZeneca: Here your platform craft drives real-world impact. You will help a data- and AI-led enterprise interpret complex data faster, make better decisions and ultimately deliver medicines to patients sooner. We unite powerful technologies, modern engineering and diverse expertise to solve problems that have not been tackled before, from scaling knowledge graphs to orchestrating secure agent ecosystems. You will be backed by meaningful investment, surrounded by curious builders who share openly, and encouraged to experiment through forums like hackathons and design reviews. End-to-End Delivery: Take ownership of migrating legacy scripts, automation flows, and backend tasks from initial network path analysis through local verification and production rollout. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of hands-on software development and automation experience with Perl and Python in a Windows environment. Strong knowledge of Windows file systems (NTFS), network pathing mechanics (UNC format vs. local paths), process execution, and environment variables. Practical experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate code conversion, script generation, and refactoring. You'll apply sound engineering judgment and help the team adopt AI-assisted development responsibly. This is an opportunity to deepen your technical skills and grow your career at the intersection of creative technology and purposeful engineering. You'll work closely with product managers, architects, UX designers, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate business and customer requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions. Success in this role means delivering complex features predictably, improving quality measurably, and becoming a trusted technical resource for the team within 12–18 months. Own and deliver complex features, enhancements, and technical initiatives independently from requirements clarification and design through implementation, automated testing, release, and follow-up; communicate progress, dependencies, and risks proactively. Translate business and customer requirements into scalable, maintainable, and high-quality technical solutions for artwork automation and structured content workflows, preserving content accuracy and traceability from source content to generated artwork. Collaborate across teams to identify, manage, and resolve dependencies that impact delivery timelines and product quality. Design reliable integrations and automation with clear API/data contracts, input validation, actionable error reporting, and safe handling of timeouts, retries, and partial failures; consider performance, security, and compatibility across supported application versions. Work with UX designers and domain experts to deliver clear, usable artwork and content-editing workflows; test content mapping and generated outputs against representative documents, templates, and edge cases. Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to architecture and implementation decisions that drive long-term product health. Articulate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to build shared understanding. Contribute to AI-powered application capabilities within WebCenter that improve artwork automation and structured content workflows where required by the product roadmap. Explore agent-based solutions, intelligent workflows, and AI-assisted product experiences where appropriate, in collaboration with architects and relevant specialists. Use approved AI-enabled development tools to assist with coding, test generation, refactoring, documentation, and investigation; independently review and validate outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, and protection of proprietary or customer data. Support fellow engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing to build a high-performing team. Promote engineering best practices, continuous learning, maintainability, and software quality across the R&D organization. Minimum Qualifications What We're Looking For These are the must-have requirements for the role: Proven, substantial hands-on experience in front-end web or full-stack software development, including production React applications, with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering and maintaining complex features in an established software product. Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS, including component design, state management, and asynchronous user-interface development; ability and willingness to learn Adobe ExtendScript and InDesign integration. Prior Adobe application or scripting experience is not required. Strong JavaScript fundamentals, including asynchronous programming, modular design, error handling, and debugging; sound software design principles and practical understanding of HTTP, browser behaviour, and client/server interactions. Experience integrating web applications with external systems through HTTP/REST APIs, including authentication, data exchange, error handling, and troubleshooting across client/server boundaries; familiarity with automated testing, code reviews, Git, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience translating UX designs into accessible, responsive, reusable UI components, including loading, empty, validation, and error states; ability to investigate browser performance and compatibility issues. Proven ability to translate business and customer requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions across the full software development lifecycle. Proven ability to diagnose complex defects using logs, browser developer tools, debugging, and profiling; improve existing code safely through automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, regression protection, and incremental refactoring. Proven ability to write maintainable JavaScript scripts or automation and adapt solutions across different scripting runtimes. Ability to take ownership under ambiguity, clarify requirements, make proportionate technical decisions, and escalate risks early while collaborating effectively across teams. Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to clearly articulate technical decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications These skills will set candidates apart: Proven hands-on technical experience with Adobe Creative Cloud applications, especially InDesign, including ExtendScript scripting and Adobe application APIs/object models; experience with InDesign Server integration is also valuable. Experience with InDesign Server automation and APIs, Adobe Illustrator, or Adobe extensibility frameworks such as CEP and/or UXP, with awareness of host-application and version compatibility. Familiarity with C++-based Adobe plug-in development as a complementary skill for WebCenter integration and Adobe application workflows. Experience with XML and structured content formats, including content modelling, parsing, validation, and transformation; relevant examples include XPath, XSLT, XML Schema (XSD), or InDesign Markup Language (IDML). Expertise in every listed format or technology is not required. Experience with template-driven publishing, content-to-layout mapping, multilingual content, or artwork/prepress workflows. Experience with Java/J2EE services, relational databases and SQL, or additional scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell. Experience modernizing established enterprise applications incrementally while preserving compatibility, security, and customer workflows. Experience designing and implementing AI-powered application capabilities, or integrating AI services into creative or enterprise software products. Familiarity with AI application patterns such as tool integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and workflow orchestration. Proven experience using AI-assisted development tools in real engineering work, with concrete examples of improved productivity or quality and critical validation of generated outputs. Experience working in Agile software development environments. About Esko It's all possible with a role at Esko . Esko, a Veralto company, is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our integrated platform and comprehensive tools empower retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to manage best-in-class packaging design and print processes. Innovation is built into the DNA of our business: every day, we challenge ourselves to be better by seeking out new ways to elevate our products, our processes, and our people. We also know that innovation and ingenuity starts with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility : where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. title: MSBI QA Tester
description: MSBI QA Testing Role:- Job Description: QA Tester (Functional/DB/ETL), in simple terms. The role in one line:- This person checks that the data and reports a client sees (dashboards, pipelines, databases) are correct, complete, and working properly before they go live. What they actually do day to day Test reports and dashboards built in Power BI and the Microsoft BI tools (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS). They compare what’s on screen with the source data. Check Power BI data models , meaning that the relationships and calculations are right and the scheduled data refresh runs without failing. Test data pipelines , which move data from one place to another (ETL = Extract, Transform, Load). They confirm nothing is lost or changed incorrectly along the way. Write SQL and BigQuery queries to compare source data with the final data. Use Python to automate checks and prepare test data. Test APIs to check that systems talk to each other correctly and handle errors. Verify business rules , for example “does the system reject invalid input?” Do non-functional testing , such as speed, large data volumes, refresh time, and security. Write and run test cases in JIRA/AIO, and log defects and follow them until they’re fixed with developers. Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by coordinating with business users and getting their sign-off. Report and escalate to the QA Lead or Delivery Manager, and join sprint meetings. Must-have skills AreaWhat to look forLanguages SQL (essential), Python Cloud/Data BigQuery , GCP services (Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub)BI tools Power BI , MSBI stack (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS)Test tools JIRA + AIO TestingWeb UI and cross-browser testing, API testing, ETL/data testingProcessAgile/Scrum, UAT managementSoft skillsAttention to detail, analytical thinking, clear communication, stakeholder follow-up Qualifications Bachelor’s in Computer Science, IT, or a related field 3-4 years of QA/testing experience ISTQB Foundation is nice to have, not mandatory Experience on data-heavy enterprise projects is a plus Screening tips for recruiting Non-negotiable: SQL plus hands-on data/ETL testing. Many QA candidates only have UI testing, which isn’t enough here. Strong differentiators: Power BI testing, BigQuery/GCP, and Python automation. Good probing questions: “How did you do source-to-target reconciliation?” “How have you tested a Power BI refresh or a report against source data?” “Have you written Python scripts to compare datasets?” Watch out for: candidates with only manual UI testing, or who list the tools but can’t explain how they used them. Realistic expectation: it’s hard to find all of this in one profile. A candidate strong in SQL and ETL testing with some Power BI or GCP exposure is a reasonable fit for 3-4 years of experience. title: Performance Reporting Analyst
description: Job Summary The Performance Reporting Analyst is responsible for consolidated performance measurement and reporting across the global portfolio and the Investment Division's other asset clusters, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. The role owns the monthly and quarterly reporting cycle: collecting and validating data from custodians, fund administrators, and external managers; computing returns against benchmarks and targets; and producing the performance packs used by the Executive Director, the Investment Committee (IC), and family shareholders. The position applies AI-enabled workflows to automate recurring extraction, reconciliation, and report production, and serves as the single source of truth for portfolio performance data across the India-based investment team and the Jeddah-based family governance structure. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Produce the monthly and quarterly consolidated performance reports covering the global portfolio and designated clusters, from custody statements, administrator reports, and manager reporting. 2. Maintain the division's performance database: positions, transactions, cash flows, and valuations, reconciled monthly to custodian and administrator records. 3. Calculate time-weighted and money-weighted returns (TWR/IRR) at portfolio, cluster, asset-class, and manager level, with realised and unrealised components separately identified. 4. Maintain the benchmark framework and produce attribution analysis by asset class, manager, and currency, explaining performance versus benchmarks and the IC's targets. 5. Prepare the quarterly IC performance pack and shareholder reporting with the Executive Director, including commentary, exceptions, and data-quality notes. 6. Track management fees, performance fees, and costs against provider agreements, and report fee drag as part of net performance analysis. 7. Build and maintain AI-enabled reporting pipelines for recurring document extraction, data validation, and report assembly, keeping human review over all published figures. 8. Liaise with the finance department to align investment performance records with the SAP accounting entries. 9. Maintain organised digital archives of all performance records, methodologies, and published reports, ensuring auditability of every reported figure. QUALIFICATIONS Minimum Education Required • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or business administration. • Strong understanding of performance measurement: TWR and IRR methodologies, benchmarking, attribution, and composite reporting (GIPS awareness preferred). • Experience with custodian and fund administrator reporting and multi-asset data (public markets, funds, private assets). • Proficient in Excel and financial systems; experience with Addepar or similar portfolio platforms preferred; working knowledge of Power BI or Python an advantage. • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools for document processing and reporting automation, with disciplined verification. • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and ability to manage recurring deadlines. Recruiter: Loshna.R Annual CTC: INR 4 - 6 LPA Role & Responsibilities 27001 GROUP - ISMS / BCMS / ITSMS Junior Auditor / Auditor / Empanel Auditor & Tutor - Information Security, Business Continuity & IT Service Management Empowering Assurance Systems Pvt Ltd | Chennai, with travel across India and overseas as required | Work From Home available for Empanel Auditor and Tutor engagements | Reports to: Technical Manager - Certification SCHEME GROUP COVERED ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) ISO 22301:2019 - Business Continuity Management Systems (BCMS) ISO/IEC 20000-1 - IT Service Management Systems (ITSMS) Related standards: ISO 27017 Cloud Security, ISO 27018 Privacy in Public Cloud, ISO 27701 PIMS, ISO 27005 and ISO 31000 Risk Management, ISO 9001 QMS as part of Integrated Management Systems. ABOUT THE ROLE Empowering Assurance Systems (EAS) / (IAS)is a certification, inspection, training and consultancy organisation. We are seeking motivated professionals with experience in information security, integrated management systems, business continuity, risk management, ISO consultancy, auditing and documentation. You will conduct audits, implement management systems, develop documentation, provide consultancy and support certification and training activities for clients across IT services, ITES, BPO, software product, fintech, healthcare IT, manufacturing and shared services sectors. Experienced auditors, consultants and tutors are encouraged to apply. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Conduct gap audits, documentation, implementation reviews, internal audit against ISO 27001, ISO 22301 and ISO 20000-1. Conducting trainings on ISO 27001, ISO 22301 and ISO 20000-1. Participate in Stage 1 readiness reviews, Stage 2 certification audits, surveillance audits and recertification audits under the guidance of the Lead Auditor. Prepare audit programmes, audit plans, scheme-specific checklists, sampling plans and audit itineraries before each engagement. Conduct opening and closing meetings, interview process owners, sample records and gather objective evidence against every applicable clause and Annex A control. Raise nonconformity reports classified as major, minor or opportunity for improvement, with clear statements of requirement, evidence and nonconformity. Review root cause analysis and corrective action plans submitted by clients, verify implementation and close out findings within the defined timelines. Prepare and submit complete audit reports, audit day records and recommendation notes to support the certification decision and technical review process. Assess the Statement of Applicability against the risk assessment and justify inclusions and exclusions of Annex A controls. Evaluate business impact analyses, recovery time and recovery point objectives, continuity strategies and the results of BCMS exercise and testing programmes. REQUIRED SKILLS - MUST HAVE Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 clauses 4 to 10 and Annex A controls. Understanding of information security governance and the risk-based approach. Risk assessment and risk treatment methodology. Internal auditing techniques: audit planning, sampling, evidence gathering, interviewing and reporting. Nonconformity classification, root cause analysis and corrective action verification. Management system documentation development. Compliance management and awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements. Technical report writing in clear, precise English. Communication, presentation and client-handling skills. Microsoft Office - Word, Excel and PowerPoint - and standard documentation tools. Willingness to travel across India and overseas. PREFERRED SKILLS - GOOD TO HAVE Business continuity planning, business impact analysis and disaster recovery planning under ISO 22301. IT service management processes under ISO/IEC 20000-1. Cloud security and privacy: ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701. Formal risk methodologies: ISO 27005, ISO 31000. Integrated Management System auditing across ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001. Experience with certification bodies, inspection bodies, consultancies or training organisations. Exposure to accreditation requirements such as ISO/IEC 17021-1. Vulnerability management, incident management or SOC exposure. Delivering training and awareness programmes as a Tutor. PREFERRED PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS Internal Auditor: ISO 27001, ISO 22301, ISO 9001, IMS Internal Auditor. Lead Auditor: IRCA / CQI certified ISO 27001, ISO 22301, ISO 9001 or IMS Lead Auditor. Additional certifications: CISA, CISSP, CEH, CompTIA Security+, ISO 27005, ISO 31000. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION Any degree. A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Cyber Security, Electronics, Management, Science or a related discipline is preferred. A Master's degree is an added advantage. EXPERIENCE Required experience: 5 to 8 years of relevant experience. Experienced: internal or external audit experience in ISO 27001, ISO 22301 or ISO 9001; ISMS or BCMS implementation; ISO consultancy; certification body or consulting organisation experience; risk assessment and treatment planning; ISMS and BCMS documentation development; information security compliance projects; integrated management system implementation and maintenance. COMPENSATION Indicative annual CTC: INR 4 - 6 LPA (Lakhs Per Annum). Actual CTC is based on experience and is fixed individually against educational qualification, auditor qualifications held, number of schemes handled, audit days completed, consultancy experience, industry experience and technical competency. Internal auditors, lead auditors, consultants, tutors and experienced certification professionals are all welcome to apply and will be assessed on the same basis. Empanel Auditor and Tutor engagements are remunerated per audit day or per training day. WORK MODE AND TRAVEL Chennai-based role with travel across India and overseas as required. Work From Home is available for Empanel Auditor and Tutor engagements. Travel, accommodation and audit-day allowances are provided as per company policy. WHY JOIN US Exposure to multiple ISO schemes and industries, structured witness and mentoring support towards Lead Auditor qualification, sponsorship of scheme competence development, and a clear progression path from Junior Auditor to Auditor, Lead Auditor and Tutor. SELECTION PROCESS HR screening call, face-to-face interview, final round. Apply with your updated CV listing your qualifications, auditor certificates and audit days completed. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Job Title : Analyst, IT Help Desk Reports to : Lead/Manager, IT Service Desk General Summary of Role : Support, diagnose and resolve first-level user incidents and fulfill first-level user requests in compliance with CommScope Service Desk standards, policies and procedures; meet or exceed CommScope’s service level, quality, customer satisfaction, user experience and job performance. Provide support via chat, telephone, email and remote support, related to workstation hardware and software, mobile devices, network connectivity, and audio, video, and web conferencing systems. Perform account administration, software installation, and other routine activities. Resolve basic issues directly; escalate more complex issues to upper-tier support functions, or where applicable, to the IT Service Desk Supervisor. Leverage the knowledge base to resolve incidents and escalate when knowledge gaps are identified. Complete all assigned learning and development activities. Demonstrate basic knowledge of the CommScope business and user segments, technology, IT functions, and Service Desk (including Service Desk tools and processes). Raise continual improvement opportunities, especially those associated with reducing ticket volume and time to repair, and to shifting demand left. Provide support for L1.5 Analyst process, technology and functional specialty area owners, and complete related tasks and training associated with these areas. This position will work remotely and in nightshift. Role requires an adaptive schedule, i.e., moving among shifts, or starting / finishing at different times to meet user demand. Duties & Responsibilities: Deliver effective user experiences and satisfaction by providing first-level support services on an assigned shift for a Spanish-based Service Desk Acquire and maintain required skill levels, including voice and chat channel skills, technical troubleshooting skills, and soft skills, e.g., emotional intelligence effective interactions Participate in HR activities as needed, e.g., onboarding and performance management Escalate to the Shift Supervisor where difficult or controversial calls are received that cannot be handed through normal functional escalation channels Provide statistics/reports and attend meetings as requested, e.g. training/awareness sessions Liaise with other Service Desk and CommScope staff as required Attend briefings on changes or deployments that may affect volumes at the Service Desk Efficiently handle user and user device demand for Service Desk services, including incident handling, service request fulfillment, standard change handling, Service Desk knowledge management/learning, support for problem management, critical incident handling and service continuity, Service Desk service level management, reporting, review, participation in audit, staff and ticket quality management, staff training and development, and continual improvement; act as an hierarchical escalation point for Service Desk Supervisors and L1.5 Analysts for issues that cannot be handled by functional escalation; escalate issues that may significantly impact the business to higher-level management in a timely, crisp manner Participate in shift-left and quality and continual improvement and automation initiatives Apply basic technical knowledge to resolve application, hardware, and services solutions Execute basic policies and procedures developed for the function Recognize, research, isolate and resolve problems related to information systems/services Coordinate referrals to appropriate technical, professional or service personnel for appropriate services, repairs, training, and follow-up Document requests, issue and applied fixes in ticketing system Perform administration of accounts in various business information systems Apply understanding and knowledge of information systems, technology, products and services to assist end-users with questions and service requests Develop end-user help sheets and technical support documentation Provide support & implementation guidance for technical solutions; review and revise support procedures as required to satisfy specific helpdesk &/or customer needs Provide support services (queue monitoring and management, incoming call management, customer request and issue resolution & escalation) and implementation deliverables Skills Required: Include demonstrated competencies and physical, mental, & interpersonal skills. ITIL® Foundation Level Certification (or equivalent) Preferred, including knowledge and experience executing ITIL best practices in an organization of similar in size, scope, and complexity as CommScope, including: incident management and service request fulfillment, and, as applicable, one or more of the following specialty areas: standard change management, Service Desk knowledge management/learning and development, support for problem management, critical incident handling and service continuity, Service Desk service level management, reporting, review, participation in audit, staff and ticket quality management, staff training and development, and continual improvement ServiceNow training and experience on modules central to the work of the Service Desk, especially incident and request management Experience with current Service Desk-related tools, e.g., those used by CommScope: CTI/AVR/ACD, e.g., Cisco Finesse, Bomgar, Hitachi password, UX/Endpoint management tools (like Next Think and MS Endpoint Manager), emoji-based EX tools (e.g., HappySignals) Strong reporting, presentation and analytical skills Ability to execute strategies, to communicate and coordinate work efforts across IT teams, and develop and maintain relationships at all levels of the organization Ability to prioritize and execute tasks while under pressure Strong written and verbal skills Highly self-motivated Experience working as a team member in a global, collaborative environment. Strong interpersonal communication skills, analytical abilities, detail orientation, quality focus, and problem-solving skills, as well as a broad knowledge of business functions and information technologies Experience in, e.g., Call Center, Customer Service and/or Help Desk support activities Knowledge of workstation support tools, common workstation applications/hardware, network connectivity, MS Windows platforms, MS Exchange/Outlook, smart phones, etc. Strong critical thinking and troubleshooting skills Highly self-motivated and self-directed, with keen attention to detail and excellent organizational skills Effective spoken and written Spanish language communication skills, along with well-spoken and written English communication skills, and the ability to impart ideas in both technical and user-friendly language Distinct customer service orientation with strong sense of ownership to effectively resolve open issues Strong team spirit with ability to work both in local and virtual team settings Desire to learn new skills and to extend knowledge into new technologies as required Occasional travel to regional offices, seminars and training Occasional evening and weekend work Sitting and operation of a computer for extended periods of time Speak Spanish fluently Ability to implement basic support plans Ability to analyze basic helpdesk requirements and solutions and adjust plans if circumstances dictate Ability to understand basic helpdesk operations success criteria and evaluate current and future helpdesk architecture scenarios Ability and technical savvy to learn and apply new technical applications Good customer skills; ability to communicate with other personnel Good attention to detail Some support management skills to include organization, communications, documentation, and cross group collaboration Ability to work independently, within tight guidelines, while maintaining priorities and flexibility Ability to minimize conflicts Ability to use Microsoft office products to include, but not limited to Word, Excel, PowerPoint

title: Product Manager, GenAI Products (Enterprise)
description: Who We Are Techdome is a product engineering company that helps enterprises move from “we should use AI” to AI running reliably in production. Our cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, and AI specialists build LLM applications, RAG systems, conversational assistants, autonomous agents, and workflow automation for clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Everything we ship comes with the security, integrations, and compliance that enterprise buyers require. The Opportunity A GenAI demo is easy to build. A GenAI product that passes a security audit, stays within budget, keeps cost per query under control, and earns the trust of its users is not. We’re hiring a Product Manager who wants to own that second problem. You’ll take products from the first client conversation through launch and growth, and you’ll be the one who catches the fuzzy requirement, the dropped handoff, or the hidden risk while it’s still cheap to fix. What You’ll Do Define the product Turn a client’s raw idea into a clear product definition with realistic scope, milestones, timelines, and budgets. Learn each client’s industry, regulations, and compliance needs, and translate them into requirements engineers can build from without guessing. Get GenAI into production Work with ML engineers to turn LLM, RAG, agent, and automation prototypes into reliable, scalable, and safe systems. Set and monitor the production metrics that matter: accuracy, latency, evaluation scores, and cost per query. Ensure every AI feature integrates with client systems through APIs and meets enterprise standards for security, data privacy, and uptime. Align the team Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so every handoff is explicit. Plan capacity and hold all parties to their commitments. Manage relationships with third-party partners, including LLM and cloud providers. Manage risk and communication Run formal change control whenever scope, timeline, or budget moves. Raise delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks early, including hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, bias, and cost overruns. Track delivery in JIRA or Azure DevOps and keep clients and leadership informed with no surprises. Use AI tools to speed up documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting. What You Bring Required 2+ years as a Product Manager delivering complex enterprise software on time and within budget. Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally having launched an LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, with a working understanding of the AI lifecycle and its risks. Experience leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOps. Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, and of tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana. Enough technical depth in the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD to challenge estimates and earn engineers’ respect. Good judgment on risk, change, vendors, and stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication, including with senior client executives. Preferred Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost optimization. PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification. Domain expertise in FinTech or Healthcare. Cross-industry experience and the curiosity to learn a new domain quickly. Your First 90 Days Days 1–30: Learn how Techdome delivers, meet the team, and get up to speed on active client projects. Days 31–60: Independently lead at least one project, owning the plan, risks, and client relationship. Days 61–90: Land a key milestone, make a visible improvement to how we run projects, and earn the trust of your team and clients. Why Join Us Technically demanding GenAI work across several industries. Daily collaboration with experienced designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts. A real voice in how projects are planned, run, and delivered. The chance to build deep expertise at the frontier of GenAI.

description: Description Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. The AOP team is an integral part of this and strives to provide Data and Science Capabilities to fulfill all customer processes in the APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Ops businesses. This BIE role sits at a rare intersection and has high growth prospects. On one side, you have cutting-edge ML/OR models making split-second cost saving decisions across Ops network. On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside, you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time, that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. In some instances you will also directly own these models. The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large-scale, low-latency data flowing through real-time pipelines. You'll design automated reporting frameworks that need to be as robust as the system they monitor. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you. What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet, they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. You'll need strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL and Python and AWS Services, and experience building scalable BI solutions. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication, and to own outcomes end-to-end rather than just deliver reports, is what will make you exceptional in this role. Directly own analytical or statistical models where appropriate. Establish Measurement Frameworks: Define KPIs, apply statistical methodologies, and develop rigorous approaches to measure model effectiveness, incremental impact, and financial benefits. Influence Cross-Functional Stakeholders: Work with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Science teams across geographies to align analytical priorities and drive adoption of data-driven solutions. Drive Technical Excellence: Establish best practices for data quality, analytical accuracy, automation, and solution scalability while improving existing BI processes and frameworks. description: DESCRIPTION Customer Experience Products (CXP) is part of Amazon's Customer Service (CS) organization, responsible for the data infrastructure that powers measurement, analytics, and automation across every customer service interaction — chat, voice, bots, and digital self-service. Our Data Engineers own the foundational data layer that BIEs, scientists, and product teams rely on to evaluate performance, shape OP planning, and drive customer-facing product improvements. You will join a team of data engineers, BIEs, and analysts who build and maintain the pipelines, schemas, and data platforms that underpin CXP's analytics ecosystem. The data you deliver directly shapes how Amazon understands and improves the customer service experience at scale — from customer journey funnels and resolver efficacy measurement to WBR automation and contact-reduction quantification. The team currently drives high-impact data engineering initiatives including migration to Gold Schema datasets, Datanet-to-Andes pipeline modernization, Panorama table consolidation, and cross-channel metrics unification. You will own meaningful data infrastructure workstreams from day one. Key job responsibilities Design and implement logical and physical data models for complex, large-scale datasets that drive downstream analytics, WBR reporting, and self-service BI infrastructure across CXP verticals (CFS, CX-STAR, Concessions/CAP). Build and optimize data pipelines (ETL/ELT) for difficult and large-scale datasets using technologies such as AWS Glue, Spark, Redshift, and EMR. Own pipeline reliability for business-critical reporting surfaces including VP-level dashboards and weekly business review decks. Own data quality end-to-end. Establish SLAs, define data certification standards, build monitoring and alerting for pipeline health, and proactively identify and resolve data quality gaps (e.g., upstream DQ issues in Panorama tables, source data discrepancies). Drive migration and modernization of data infrastructure. Lead migration of team-owned objects to dedicated schemas (e.g., Datanet-to-Andes migration), consolidate reporting tables to eliminate redundant queries, and align data sources to Gold Schema standards for consistent, auditable metrics. Improve self-service access to data. Build tools and processes for data lineage tracking, discoverability, and governance. Reduce manual reporting overhead by engineering automated solutions that enable analysts and PMs to self-serve. Partner cross-functionally with SDEs, BIEs, scientists, and PMs to understand data needs, propose solutions, and deliver datasets that enable stakeholders to make data-driven decisions. Integrate data solutions into broader team architecture and ensure alignment with CS Data & AI team dependencies. Automate manual processes and improve operational excellence. Improve code quality, dependency management, and pipeline observability. Reduce BIE bandwidth consumed by manual data preparation work. Mentor and develop peers. Participate in hiring, technical assessments, and code reviews. Raise the bar on data engineering practices across the team. A day in the life You might start your morning validating a pipeline migration that consolidates conversation and interaction ID attributes into a unified Panorama reporting table — eliminating the need for analysts to query multiple sources. After standup, you investigate a data quality gap in an upstream concessions table, root-cause the issue, and coordinate with the source team on a fix. In the afternoon, you build a new ETL job to power a customer journey funnel dataset that tracks the full path from CSHP entry through bot interaction to resolution. Before end of day, you review a teammate's pipeline code and help optimize a Spark job that's approaching its SLA window. We thrive on solving challenging data problems to build the infrastructure our customers — the analysts, scientists, and PMs who drive CS improvements — depend on every day.
